(C.I.D.) Office Notes

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
File No. REGISTRY
No. I. O. D...705..
Date..29...11...29.

Sir,

The 14.000.000 Roubles were auctioned in Messrs
L. Moore & Co.'s premises, Kiangse Road at 10 a.m.
on November 23. Dr. Kornet, a naturalised American
of Russian origin, residing at 18 Carter Road, purchased
them for $6.00. They were put into auction by a Chinese.

A. Robertson.
D. I.

"Kerensky" & 100. Q3.

14.000.000 Roubles to be auctioned off.

At one of the Auction rooms to-day bonds to the
value of 14.000.000 Roubles of the "Freedom Loan", which
had been ordered by the Kerensky Government in America
and circulated as paper currency in Siberia in 1919,
together with some "Kerensky" notes, will be sold.
Former values have been put for auction by Chinese.

The bonds of 200 Roubles each, represent a good
sized bale, being tied together.
pages.zh:
“克伦斯基”及 100. Q3.

14,000,000 卢布将被拍卖。

在今日的一间拍卖行内，将出售面值总计 14,000,000 卢布的“自由公债”债券，该债券系克伦斯基政府于 1919 年在美国订购，并在西伯利亚作为纸币流通，连同一些“克伦斯基”纸币一并出售。此前的估值是由华人提出的。

这些面值为 200 卢布的债券捆扎在一起，构成一个大包。
